game_title: Discount Rules – Pearl Divers' Lagoon Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon, a lagoon of pearl divers: the dock cartographer must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Pearl Divers' Lagoon: a lagoon of pearl divers
core_gameplay_loop: In Pearl Divers' Lagoon, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round, rogue crabs strike the signal flag, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the profit value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the signal flag from rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon: keep the profit meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: profit drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pearl Divers' Lagoon'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Pearl Divers' Lagoon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while profit > 0.
